en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a decorative ceiling or panel layout divided into triangular and oval sections with ornate borders. Each section contains religious imagery: scenes from the life of Christ (including the Crucifixion) and portraits of saints rendered in a classical Catholic style. Around the circular portraits, Latin names of saints are inscribed.
